title: Applications and places, Valmarina School of Law, 2020-2024
bodyMd: The chart shows, for each admissions cycle from 2020 to 2024, the number of applications the Valmarina School of Law received and the number of places it offered.

data.caption: Applications received and places offered at the Valmarina School of Law in each admissions cycle from 2020 to 2024.

accessibilityText: A grouped bar chart with one pair of bars per year from 2020 to 2024; the taller bar of each pair is applications received and the shorter is places offered. In 2020 there were 4,800 applications and 600 places. In 2021 there were 5,400 applications and 600 places. In 2022 there were 6,000 applications and 750 places. In 2023 there were 6,600 applications and 750 places. In 2024 there were 7,200 applications and 900 places. Applications rise by exactly 600 each year; places stay flat for two years at a time before stepping up.

provenance.notes: Invented data for a fictional institution. The figures were chosen so that the applications-per-place ratio can be computed mentally without a calculator.
